title: Scalar Ext external cup agrees with the ordinary module cup of pullbacks
statement: The scalar external cup of classes x and y in degrees p and q on schemes X and Y over a field equals (-1)^(p*q) times the ordinary module cup of their module-cohomology pullbacks to X times Y, whenever the supplied module cup has its usual unsigned resolution pairing characterization. Definitions and comparison data: [def-weil-field], [def-pc-scheme], [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], [def-sc-module-cohomology-cup-product], [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

source.place: Tag 01F7 (cohomology-section-functoriality), Tag 0FKV (cohomology-lemma-diagrams-commute), and Varieties Tag 0BED (varieties-equation-kunneth-on-cech); agent-written scalar Ext specialization of these operations.

proof.text: Expand externalCup as the scalar cup of the pullbacks. Apply signed scalar/module cup compatibility to the given ordinary cup. Replace both pullback classes using scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison; lift this equality through the integer action. The result is (-1)^(p*q) times the ordinary external module cup.

theorem scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace q).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hcup :
      ∀ (D : CupResolutionPairing
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
            ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G))
        (a : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
          (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.left.K).sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (b : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
          (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.right.K).sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (c : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
          (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.target.K).sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
        c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val →
          cup (D.left.class p a) (D.right.class q b) = D.target.class (p + q) c)
    (x : scalarCohomology f F p) (y : scalarCohomology g G q) :
    externalCup f g F G p q x y =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p * q) •
        cup (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) F p x)
          (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) G q y)

statement_change.old_statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], f:X -> Spec k and g:Y -> Spec k be schemes [def-pc-scheme], F on X and G on Y arbitrary module sheaves, and p,q natural numbers. For any ordinary module cup product cup of pr1^*F and pr2^*G characterized by IsModuleCupProduct [def-sc-module-cohomology-cup-product], and x in scalarCohomology(f,F,p), y in scalarCohomology(g,G,q) [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], externalCup(f,g,F,G,p,q,x,y), on its underlying module-cohomology carrier, equals cup(moduleCohomologyPullback(pr1,F,p,x), moduleCohomologyPullback(pr2,G,q,y)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No Cech cover, comparison, cochain, or total cycle is assumed.
statement_change.what: The unsigned comparison omitted the Koszul factor. scalarExtCup composes the left class first; the two shift orders differ by (-1)^(p*q). The existing private (1,1) rational single-complex calculation verifies a nonzero sign discrepancy. Insert the factor on the resolution or ordinary module-cup side; canonical Cech product comparisons carry it on their left side.

old_proof.text: Unfold externalCup. Apply scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility on the fiber product to the two scalar pullbacks, with the unchanged resolution characterization hypothesis. Use scalar_moduleCohomologyPullback_comparison for each projection (rfl for the first, pullback.condition.symm for the second). Apply congrArg₂ to cup and compose the equalities.
